name: salary-float-native-probe
description: Isolated macOS interaction feasibility experiment; not the product

scripts.check: node --check main.cjs && node --check preload.cjs && node --check renderer.cjs && node --check panel.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:gesture && npm run test:presentation
scripts.test:gesture: mkdir -p build/module-cache && xcrun swiftc -module-cache-path build/module-cache native/GestureState.swift native/GestureStateTests.swift -o build/gesture-tests && ./build/gesture-tests
scripts.test:presentation: mkdir -p build/module-cache && xcrun swiftc -module-cache-path build/module-cache native/PresentationGeometry.swift native/PresentationGeometryTests.swift -o build/geometry-tests && ./build/geometry-tests
scripts.native:build: mkdir -p build/module-cache && xcrun swiftc -module-cache-path build/module-cache native/preflight.swift -o build/preflight
